name: 経路沿いのカテゴリ一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Correct just ONE component LH01-0005, the six-tile category grid. Input1 is generated candidate to edit. Input2 ORIGINAL source is authoritative for icon glyph geometry/proportions/optical weight, alignment and fine details. Input3 rough Japanese mock is secondary content and exact Regular typography reference. Input4 is approved Lighthouse surface style only.
Targeted correction ONLY: every Japanese label in input1 is too bold. Render all6labels in delicate Japanese Meiryo REGULAR, weight400,14px/24px at logical390px grid width, tracking0, uniformly scaled; match thin letter-stroke appearance of input3, do NOT use semibold/bold or increase size. Exact labels/order: top ガソリン / 食事 / カフェ; bottom 買い物 / 休憩所 / 宿泊. Maintain one line per label.
Keep all six source-shaped filled glyphs, equal3×2white rounded tiles, neutral borders, faint shadows, unchanged layout and no selected tile. Use original source filled pump/hose, forkknife, coffee cup/saucer, cart, manwoman restroom figures and bed. The original blue category-action group is adapted consistently to ONE forest-green #1F6444 across glyphs+labels; no per-categorycolors, mint fills or new controls. Pure-white #FFFFFF outer canvas and surfaces. Preserve all other content and proportions, only lighten label weight. High-resolution flat frontal landscape3:2 component, no extra text/artwork/device.
reviewNotes: ラベルの太さだけを軽減し6種の日本語と原参照優先の塗りつぶし図形を再確認。3列2段、未選択の白い操作タイル、ガソリン・食事・カフェ・買い物・休憩所・宿泊を保持。原の青い一貫した操作グループを森林緑一色へ適用しランダムな分類色なし。欠けと余計な項目なし。静止画像のエージェントレビューのみ、厳密フォント一致・所有者承認・編集可能性・実装は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
